tasks.title: Create model lab-machines
tasks.instructions:
Create a new model named `lab-machines`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-machines
```

Verify that `lab-machines` is the active model:

```bash
juju switch
```

tasks.title: Provision standalone machine
tasks.instructions:
Provision a standalone machine in the model without deploying an application yet:

```bash
juju add-machine
```

Verify that machine `0` exists:

```bash
juju machines
```
hints: Use `juju add-machine` to allocate a new machine in the model.

tasks.title: Deploy application with placement directive
tasks.instructions:
Deploy the `ubuntu` charm with alias `custom-node` placed explicitly on machine `0`:

```bash
juju deploy ubuntu custom-node --to 0 --channel latest/stable
```

Verify in `juju status` that `custom-node/0` is placed on machine `0`:

```bash
juju status
```
hints: Use the `--to 0` flag to target machine 0.
